TrackerContract.description: Tracker Contract v1 wire shape. Run the parser for field uniqueness, mapping compatibility, safe JSON bounds, credential checks and semantic diagnostics.

transports.browser: domain services; human Decisions remain browser-only
transports.http: v1 data envelope, strong ETag/If-Match, Idempotency-Key, X-Correlation-Id
transports.mcp: consolidated action families; upload handles and bounded base64 chunks; no local filesystem or persistent execution
transports.rendererSdk: commentary-tracker-v1 host broker only; no API credentials, Decision or direct Git write
transports.events: ordered durable outbox; authorized opaque cursor pages, 10-second waits and bounded SSE batches; additive signed webhook wakeups

error.message: Authentication required. Reconnect the Agent or sign in again, then use an active credential with the required grant.
